name: Kuga Tatsuomi
source:
Ryokuha's father and a priest of the Marenis religion.
A strict individual who serves as the director of Marenis General Hospital, he wishes for Ryokuha to become a priest.

"When I mentioned that my son goes to this school, the miko-sama said she wanted to meet you."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=11]official website[/url]]
